title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
statement: Given a sequence of scores, find the length of the longest subsequence (not necessarily contiguous) whose values are strictly increasing.
input_format: The first line contains n. The second line contains n integers.
output_format: Print the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

examples.explanation: 2 3 7 18 is one longest strictly increasing subsequence, length 4.

hints: A quadratic dynamic programme is correct but too slow for 200000 values.
Keep, for every length, the smallest possible last value of an increasing subsequence of that length.
That list stays sorted, so binary search tells you where each new value goes.
